callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a path to an existing directory
callees.post_condition: Returns a CodeGraphExtractor instance initialized with the project source index, or None if initialization fails

callees.name: get_call_edges
callees.pre_condition: language is a recognized language key
callees.post_condition: Returns a dict mapping each caller identifier to the set of callee identifiers it directly invokes, for all source files of the specified language
